Beige Book - March 2023

Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas

Summary of Economic Activity

Growth stalled as banking stress rippled through the District, and uncertainty surged.

Contacts reported widespread uncertainty and rising risks to the outlook.

Labor Markets

Hiring slowed sharply amid uncertain demand for workers.

Layoffs picked up, and employment expectations weakened notably.

Firms froze job openings, citing uncertainty about credit conditions.

Wage growth slowed as labor market conditions deteriorated.

Prices

Price growth moderated.

Fuel costs declined.
